definition: Individualism means the belief that each person should think, choose, and act independently — that the single person, not the group, is what matters most.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word individualism. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know individualism should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: The studio's founder prized individualism, hiring animators whose portfolios matched no house style.
Independence is weaker than individualism: an independent person simply manages without help, while individualism turns that independence into a creed a whole life is built on.
Egoism goes further than individualism: individualism asks that every person be free to choose, while egoism dismisses everyone else's claims entirely.

Self-reliance is the practical habit of counting on your own hands and resources. Individualism raises that habit into a creed: not just managing alone, but believing the single person is what society exists for.

Nonconformity is defined by what it refuses — the customs and expectations everyone else follows. Individualism is the positive doctrine underneath: the person comes first, whether or not any custom is being defied.

Autonomy is the condition of governing yourself — a question of who holds authority, asked of nations, regions, and patients. Individualism is the belief that such self-rule matters most; autonomy is the arrangement, individualism the creed.

When the city offered the Pell Prize to a design team, the jury chair, Ruth Okada, sent it back with a letter that made the papers.
The award, she wrote, honored teamwork so automatically that it had forgotten what she called the plain truth of individualism: buildings, like poems, begin as one person's conviction.
Her critics answered that architecture is the most collective of arts.
Okada agreed — and held her ground anyway.
Cooperation, she wrote, is how a vision gets built.
It is not where a vision comes from.
The single mind, she insisted, is what the whole collaboration exists to serve.
The city never changed the prize.
But for years afterward, every jury felt obliged to say which one person's idea it was rewarding.
